role: Verbatim prompt prose for the AI coach: base persona + hard rules + medical boundary, non-tool overlay, tool-use overlay (envelope, grounding rules, location/workout/live/mutation/web-search rules), voice overlay, and condensed Apple base/tool/no-tool/voice overlays.
toplevel: Only static string constants; no functions. Consumed by AIProvider+SystemPrompt.swift (stableSections, toolModeSections, appleInstructions; appleInstructions also detects tool/voice turns by substring-matching toolOverlay/voiceOverlay in the composed prompt). States a tool budget of 8 matching AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:30 maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8 and recovery weights 60/25/15, 70/30, Comeback 80/20/0 consistent with ScoreDetailBuilder.

flags.text: toolOverlay grounding rule 5 tells the model to confirm each number 'appears verbatim in a <data> block', while base BREVITY forbids emitting `<data>...</data>` blocks; the model is told to audit against a construct it is told never to produce.

voiceOverlay instructs spoken-form numbers ('one-sixty', 'four miles') and base rule 1 gives 'Your HR is 150' / 'TSB is -8.8' as the format, none of which the MetricsVerifier live or training-load patterns can match (they need digits plus 'bpm', and 'TSB <number>' with nothing between), so the prompt steers the model away from the formats the hallucination guard checks.

toolOverlay describes static-context content no recipient of it receives: a '📍 LOCATION:' line, a LIVE WORKOUT block with snapshot_age_sec and a 14-session preview. Cloud tool-mode providers get contextRendered = '' and Apple has toolOverlay replaced by appleToolOverlay, and the same overlay says 'There is NO data pre-loaded'.
